locations.name: Kilteevan Village
locations.description_template: A muddy road runs between low stone walls and a handful of whitewashed cottages. Smoke lifts from the clustered roofs. A lane leads east to the Letter Office and a rutted boreen runs west to Connolly Cottage. The {weather} sky hangs over the road. It is {time}.

connections.path_description: a short lane east to the whitewashed Letter Office
a rutted boreen west to Connolly Cottage

locations.mythological_significance: Cill Taobháin means Taobhán's church. The old people say the saint kept his cell near where the road bends.
locations.geo_source: OS 6-inch First Edition, Roscommon sheet, ca. 1837 (Kilteevan village)

locations.name: Letter Office
locations.description_template: A narrow counter, pigeonholes of folded paper, and a small turf fire. The room smells of sealing wax, turf smoke, and damp wool. Through the window the weather is {weather}. It is {time}.

connections.path_description: the lane back west to the village road

locations.name: Connolly Cottage
locations.description_template: A peat fire warms the single room. A scrubbed table, a spinning wheel by the hearth, and rain-dark coats by the door. Outside the weather is {weather}. It is {time}.

connections.path_description: the boreen climbing east to the village road
